brief.concept: How Much Do Underdog Picks Pay? Calculate Payouts Before You Enter
brief.primary_question: How do I calculate a possible Underdog Pick'em payout before submitting an entry?
brief.audience: Adults researching Underdog Pick'em Standard and Flex payout math, including first-time calculator users
brief.learning_outcome: Multiply the entry amount by the displayed multiplier, use Propeller only to estimate scenarios, and confirm the current Underdog entry screen and eligibility
brief.cta: Use https://propellerpicks.com/tools/underdog-payout-calculator/ for independent scenario math, then verify the current amount and eligibility in Underdog
brief.freshness_requirements: Recheck official Underdog payout and state-eligibility help before publication; never show the local page's stale 4-pick Standard value; current entry screen controls

sources.note: Current Standard and Flex base payouts; payouts include entry fee; Flex supports 3-8 picks; modifiers and correlations can adjust amounts
Flex lower-result values are up-to amounts; Champions prize-pool results can vary
Pick'em availability varies by physical location and unavailable modes may not appear
Physical location determines Classic versus Champions availability
Current local calculator scenario estimator; video uses only 5-pick Standard and 6-pick Flex values that match the current official table
